param: k Fraction of human recruits that are vaccinated at birth/recruitment
μ₁ Natural death rate of humans
θ Rate of vaccine immunity loss (vaccine failure / waning)
ε Vaccine efficacy (reduces susceptibility to mosquito infection in vaccinated class)
ηS Effective contact rate of susceptible humans with infectious mosquitoes (vector transmission)
ηV Effective contact rate of vaccinated humans with infectious mosquitoes (vector transmission)
ξS Effective contact rate of susceptible humans with infectious humans (non-vector transmission)
ξV Effective contact rate of vaccinated humans with infectious humans (non-vector transmission)
φ₁ Progression rate from vector-exposed humans (E_H1) to infectious humans (I_H)
φ₂ Progression rate from non-vector-exposed humans (E_H2) to infectious humans (I_H)
β₄₁ Human malaria disease-induced death rate
σ Progression rate from infectious humans (I_H) to treated humans (T_H)
ω Progression rate from treated humans (T_H) to recovered humans (R_H)
γ Rate of immunity loss in recovered humans (R_H -> S_H)
μ₂ Natural death rate of mosquitoes
ρ Effective contact rate of susceptible mosquitoes with infectious humans (human-to-mosquito transmission)
φ Progression rate from exposed mosquitoes (E_M) to infectious mosquitoes (I_M)
